title: Darkium
description: A simple mod-pack that includes many performance mods along with some QoL mods.
body:
# Darkium
### About
I initially used other mod-packs as foundations and usually layered my own mods on top of them, repeating this for every Minecraft instance. Learning more about mod-packs, I have decided to make my own.

### Features
The mod-pack includes many renowned and must-have performance mods, namely Sodium, Lithium, and Ferrite Core, while also including subtle visual mods and resource packs such as Visual Effects+, and Enchantment Outlines. It also includes stuble yet extremely helpful mods like In-Game Account Switcher and Skin Shuffle, while also having very niche mods like e4mc.
